scope: Scoped official election and effective vacancy review; historical snapshots retained; not an exhaustive all-council or current-roster audit.

facts.finding: NSWEC Notice 3, dated 29 October 2026, declares Barry Knight elected in an uncontested election. No voting is required. The superseded November timetable is retained in history.

Council news index, dated 15 October 2026, explicitly records Marc Lane resignation effective immediately. Linked detail page returned 403; index evidence retained. Confirmed replacement poll 12 December, nominations close 11 November noon AEDT.

Council confirms mayoral vacancy following resignation received 28 October 2026; Julie Talty continues as Acting Mayor. By-election required; polling and nomination timetable remains unconfirmed. Subsequent postal-vote request remains subject to approval.

Direct council article confirms vacant Milngin Ward councillor position and replacement by-election being arranged, timetable awaiting NTEC. Conflicting indexed December dates were excluded. The earlier failed August nomination round remains historical; NTEC current-elections page lists no current elections.

Page 6, resolution 142.09.2026, receives and notes Harley Toomey resignation effective Wednesday 9 September 2026. Historical ballots retained; current role replaced using separate NSWEC 29 October declaration.

Council 29 October special meeting agreed to seek a fully postal mayoral by-election. Application through ECQ for Minister consideration remains subject to approvals, not an issued election timetable.
